name: Summon Felsteed
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 320 experience instead of 300, 1.07 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I would give you a reward for your patience and hard work. But know this, the ability to summon a Felsteed will be much more difficult in the future. You will have to earn it... and it will not be easy.

For now, go with the power to summon such a creature and use it as you see fit.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good luck, adventurer. I look forward to seeing you in the future.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 40, 640 XP in all.
